duration: 3 Hours • Departure times are adjusted to seasonal sunset patterns.
location_address: 2720 Shelter Island Drive San Diego, CA US 92106
description: Enjoy an evening on a spacious 40ft sailboat for a 3-hour San Diego Sunset Cruise. Taking a sunset sail may prove to be among the most romantic and relaxing moments of your day. San Diego sunset sails are very special here and are typically associated with calm ocean conditions, as the ocean breezes usually die down at sunset. Our sunsets aboard a beautiful sailboat will take your breath away, leave you speechless and slow down time if only for a moment.
what_is_included: All beer, non-alcoholic drinks and snacks are complimentary.
